title: Bill 90 requiring underground utility lines
summary: Bill 90, which would amend the county subdivision law to require more utility lines underground, remains in committee after no motion passed on 25 February 2025. The committee voted 8–0 to amend it, changing a housing component to "workforce housing," and will bring in the Housing department. Members worry about costs: undergrounding for a 161-lot Department of Hawaiian Home Lands (DHHL) project would run $21,000 per lot versus $700 to $800 overhead.
